set.body: Foundation for Open Recent and layout persistence under S2.9/S1.5b. Add a concrete desktop preferences repository that patches the latest file under a cross-process writer lock, retains atomic replacement and corrupt-file preservation, and keeps appearance saves from overwriting unrelated recent/layout fields. Validate concurrent independent repository instances, failure/lock release, and appearance integration. Wire the repository into StudioMain. Open Recent menu and lifecycle admission are a following slice.
set.title: Desktop preference patches: preserve recent projects and layouts across concurrent writers
